users.can_remote_target_edit: Can add and edit RDP and VNC targets
users.can_remote_target_delete: Can delete RDP and VNC targets
users.can_remote_target_test: Can test RDP and VNC targets

users.can_org_manage_devices: Can add and remove devices in organizations

users.can_mesh_files: Can use files on MeshCentral agents
users.can_mesh_power: Can turn MeshCentral agents on and off
users.can_agent_terminal: Can use the terminal on NeoDesk agents
users.can_agent_files: Can use files on NeoDesk agents

users.sign_in_link_copy_failed: The link could not be copied. Allow this site to use the clipboard and try again.
users.message_failed: The conversation could not be opened. Try again, or open Chat and find the person there.
users.time_zone_invalid: Choose a time zone from the list.
users.time_zone_hint: Mails to this person give times in this time zone.
users.profile_from_provider: This account signs in with {provider}. The name comes from there and is set again at each sign-in.
users.display_name_hint: The console shows first and last name. Without them it shows the username {username}.
users.page_not_found: This user doesn't exist or was deleted. Go back to the users list to find the account.
users.page_no_permission: You don't have permission to see users. Ask an administrator for it.
users.page_load_failed: The user could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
users.page_role_nothing: This role allows nothing in the console.
users.page_role_note: A role allows the same for everyone who has it. Console access can still close sections for one person or group.
users.page_scope_unknown: The number of devices could not be read. Reload the page to try again.
users.page_scope_all_why: No user group, folder or device list limits this account.
users.page_scope_nothing_given: No user group, folder or device is given to this account. Edit it to give it access.
users.page_orgs_none: Not a member of any organization.
users.page_orgs_unknown: The organizations could not be read. Reload the page to try again.
users.page_2fa_required: Two-factor sign-in is required and not set up yet
users.page_must_change: Chooses a new password at the next sign-in
users.page_reset_waiting: A reset link waits, it works until {date}
users.page_sessions_above: You can't change this account, so its signed-in devices aren't shown.
users.page_sessions_need_edit: Signed-in devices are shown to people who may edit users.
users.page_tokens_failed: The API tokens could not be loaded. Try again.
users.page_tokens_none: This account has made no API tokens.
users.page_activity_need_audit: Activity comes from the audit log. You need the permission to view audit logs to see it.
users.page_activity_failed: The activity could not be loaded. Try again.
users.page_activity_none: Nothing in the audit log by or about this account yet.
users.page_events_none: No sign-ins or security events yet.
users.page_withdraw_consequence: The invite link stops working and the account, which never signed in, is deleted.
users.page_disable_consequence: {username} can't sign in until the account is enabled again. Their sessions end; the account and its history stay.
users.page_delete_consequence: The account is gone for good. You can hand its tokens, organizations, reports and tickets to someone else first.
users.bulk_too_many: One request takes up to {max} accounts.
users.bulk_skip_own: Your own account is left out. Change it on its own.
users.bulk_role_directory: This account gets its role from LDAP/AD.
users.import_too_large: The file is larger than {size}. Split it into smaller files.
users.import_too_many_rows: The file has more than {max} accounts. Split it into smaller files.
users.import_empty: The file has no accounts. The first line names the columns, every other line is one account.
users.import_no_username: The first line must name the columns, with one called username. Start from the template.
users.import_bad_csv: Line {line} can't be read as CSV. Check the quotes on it.
users.import_username_taken: An account with this username exists.
users.import_username_twice: This username is on line {line} too.
users.import_email_missing: An invite needs an email address.
users.import_email_taken: An account with this email address exists.
users.import_email_twice: This email address is on line {line} too.
users.import_name_too_long: A name can have up to {max} characters.
users.import_org_permission: You can't add accounts to organizations.
users.import_org_unreadable: The organizations can't be read right now. Try again.
users.import_invite_failed: The invite mail didn't go out. Send it again from the users list.
users.bulk_checking: Checking what this does to each account…
users.bulk_nothing: None of the selected accounts would change.
users.bulk_already_one: 1 account is so already and stays as it is.
users.bulk_already_many: {count} accounts are so already and stay as they are.
users.bulk_no_orgs: There are no organizations yet. Create one under Organizations first.
users.bulk_role_effect: The accounts get the new role. Their sessions and access tokens end, so they sign in again.
users.bulk_enable_effect: The accounts can sign in again.
users.bulk_disable_effect: The accounts can't sign in until they are enabled again. Their sessions and access tokens end. Nothing is deleted.
users.bulk_org_add_effect: The accounts become members of the organization.
users.bulk_org_remove_effect: The accounts stop being members of the organization. The accounts themselves stay.
users.bulk_two_factor_effect: Accounts without two-factor sign-in set it up at their next sign-in. Only for accounts with a password in the console.
users.bulk_password_change_effect: The accounts choose a new password at their next sign-in. Their sessions go on until then.
users.bulk_reset_link_effect: Each account gets a mail with a link to set a new password. The link works once, for 24 hours. The password stays until it is used.
users.bulk_delete_effect: The accounts are deleted for good. Their API tokens are revoked and their organization memberships go; the audit log keeps their history. To hand their things to someone else, delete one account at a time.
users.import_intro: Make many accounts at once from a CSV file, for example one saved from Excel.
users.import_columns: The first line names the columns: username (required), email (required for invites), first name, last name, role, organization and language. An empty role is viewer, the organization is its name, the language a code like en or de. Commas or semicolons, up to 1000 accounts.
users.import_mode_invite_hint: Each gets a mail in their language with a link to choose a password.
users.import_mode_invite_off: Needs the email settings. Set them up under Settings, Email.
users.import_mode_temporary_hint: You get a password for each, shown once. They choose a new one at their first sign-in.
users.import_mode_none_hint: They can't sign in until you give them a temporary password or send an invite from the users list.
users.import_file_hint: Up to 1 MB. Nothing is made until you choose Import.
users.import_unreadable: The file can't be read. Choose it again.
users.import_problems: Lines with problems are left out. Fix them in the file and choose it again.
users.import_invites_sent: Their invites went to their email addresses.
users.import_none_next: They can't sign in yet. Give each a temporary password from its row menu, or send invites once email is set up.
users.import_passwords_hint: Download or copy them before you close this. Give each person theirs; they choose a new one at their first sign-in.
users.invalid_device_id_one: ID perangkat hanya berisi huruf, angka, dan . _ - : @.
users.access_now_chosen: Pengguna ini melihat perangkat dari kelompok pengguna dan folder yang dipilih, serta perangkat langsung.
users.access_now_none_restricted: Tidak ada yang dipilih: pengguna ini tidak melihat perangkat apa pun, karena visibilitas perangkat Terbatas.
users.access_now_none_open: Tidak ada yang dipilih: pengguna ini melihat semua perangkat, karena visibilitas perangkat Terbuka.
users.access_no_effect_admin: Tidak berpengaruh selama perannya {role}: peran ini selalu melihat semua perangkat.
users.user_direct_devices_rows: Satu ID perangkat per baris, misalnya 123456789. Pengguna melihat perangkat ini apa pun folder dan grupnya.
users.group_dialog_intro: Anggota grup berbagi akses konsol grup itu dan grup perangkat yang mengizinkannya. Tambahkan orang di lembar penggunanya; izinkan grup di pengaturan akses grup perangkat.
users.group_name_hint: Tampil di daftar pengguna, di lembar pengguna setiap anggota, dan di pengaturan akses.
users.access_own_user_limit: Diatur untuk orang ini. Batas peran: {limit}

remote.file_transfer_unavailable_cdap: Transfer file tidak tersedia untuk sesi snapshot CDAP.
remote.file_local_upload_hint: Letakkan file di kotak kiri atau klik untuk mengunggah. Tujuan adalah folder yang terbuka di sisi remote.
remote.file_no_local_tree: Pilih folder untuk menelusuri file lokal (opsional)

remote.file_folder_download_desktop_only: Unduhan folder memerlukan RdClient desktop. Unduh file satu per satu, atau gunakan RdClient desktop.
remote.clipboard_paste_hint: Hanya sinkron clipboard — tidak berfungsi di login Windows. Gunakan Ketik teks untuk kata sandi.

remote.signin_menu: Sign in with the saved details
remote.signin_bar: A sign-in is saved for this computer.
remote.signin_bar_signed_in: Someone is signed in on this computer. Use Sign in only while the screen shows the lock screen.
remote.signin_no_lock_signal: This computer doesn't report its lock screen. Use Sign in when you see it.
remote.signin_unsupported_platform: Saved sign-in works on Windows computers only.
remote.signin_unsupported_service: NeoDesk on this computer runs without its service, so it can't type at the lock screen.
remote.signin_confirm_title: Sign in at the lock screen?
remote.signin_confirm: Someone is signed in on {name}. Use Sign in only while the screen shows the lock screen: on an open desktop the password would be typed into whatever has the focus.
remote.signin_busy: Signing in with the saved details…
remote.signin_typed: The saved details were typed. If Windows shows an error, sign in by hand: they are not tried again in this session.
remote.signin_stopped: The session ended before the saved details were typed.
remote.signin_already_used: Sign in was already used in this session.
remote.signin_session_not_open: The server does not see this session as open. Reconnect and try again.
remote.signin_not_set: No sign-in details are saved for this computer any more.
remote.signin_cannot_open: The saved details can't be read with this server's key. Save them again.
remote.signin_unavailable: This server can't use saved sign-in details right now.
remote.signin_failed: Sign in did not work. Sign in by hand.
remote.signin_sealed_required: NeoDesk on this computer signs in by itself, but not in this session, so the server hands out no readable details. Update NeoDesk on the computer.
remote.signin_no_device_key: The server has no key of this computer, so it can't seal the sign-in for it.
remote.signin_sealed_typed: NeoDesk on the computer typed the saved details. If Windows shows an error, sign in by hand: they are not tried again in this session.
remote.signin_not_at_lock_screen: NeoDesk on the computer typed nothing: it isn't at the lock or sign-in screen.
remote.signin_expired: The sign-in request had expired when it reached the computer. Check the computer's clock.
remote.signin_bad_blob: NeoDesk on the computer couldn't open the sign-in request.
remote.signin_no_answer: NeoDesk on the computer didn't answer the sign-in request.
remote.signin_sealed_sent: Sent to NeoDesk on the computer…
remote.signin_path_sealed: NeoDesk on the computer types it: the password never reaches this browser.
remote.clipboard_on_hint: Salin dan tempel berjalan dua arah, teks dan gambar: Ctrl+C dan Ctrl+V di layar jarak jauh. Klik untuk menonaktifkan papan klip.
remote.clipboard_off_hint: Papan klip nonaktif. Klik untuk mengaktifkannya.
remote.clipboard_off_device: Komputer jarak jauh atau server ini menonaktifkan papan klip untuk sesi ini.
remote.clipboard_permission_hint: Salin dan tempel berjalan. Izinkan akses papan klip sekali, dan yang Anda salin di sini sampai ke komputer jarak jauh begitu Anda kembali ke penampil.
remote.clipboard_pending_hint: Ada yang disalin di komputer jarak jauh. Klik di sini, atau tekan tombol atau klik di layar jarak jauh, untuk menyalinnya ke komputer ini.
remote.clipboard_http_note: Halaman ini memakai HTTP biasa, jadi browser tidak memberinya akses papan klip. Ctrl+V di layar jarak jauh tetap mengirim teks dan gambar. Teks yang disalin di komputer jarak jauh sampai ke komputer ini pada tekan tombol atau klik berikutnya di layar jarak jauh; gambar tidak.

cross_platform.title: Kompatibilitas Lintas Platform
cross_platform.matrix_hint: Fitur mana yang berfungsi di sistem mana. Tab “Batasan” menjelaskan arti dukungan sebagian untuk setiap sistem.
cross_platform.no_devices: Belum ada perangkat yang terdaftar di server ini.

cross_platform.no_codec_data: Belum ada perangkat online yang melaporkan kodeknya.
cross_platform.no_feature_data: Belum ada perangkat online yang melaporkan fiturnya.

cross_platform.limit_win_uac: Menginstal layanan, serta mengendalikan layar masuk atau permintaan admin, memerlukan persetujuan administrator (UAC).
cross_platform.limit_win_service: Berjalan sebagai layanan Windows dengan akun layanannya sendiri. Hak administrator hanya diperlukan untuk menginstalnya.

cross_platform.limit_linux_wayland: Di desktop Wayland, perekaman layar hanya berfungsi melalui portal berbagi layar PipeWire.
cross_platform.limit_linux_pipewire: Suara memerlukan PipeWire. PulseAudio juga berfungsi, dengan batasan.
cross_platform.limit_linux_arm: Tersedia build untuk ARM64. Di sana, beberapa format video didekode secara perangkat lunak, yang lebih lambat.
cross_platform.limit_mac_screen: Perekaman layar harus diizinkan di Pengaturan Sistem > Privasi & Keamanan.
cross_platform.limit_mac_signing: Untuk membagikan agen ke Mac, agen harus ditandatangani dengan Apple Developer ID.
cross_platform.limit_mac_notarize: Di luar App Store, macOS baru membuka agen setelah Apple memeriksanya (notarisasi).
cross_platform.limit_android_projection: Orang di perangkat harus menyetujui setiap kali layar dibagikan.
cross_platform.limit_android_accessibility: Keyboard dan mouse jarak jauh memerlukan layanan aksesibilitas yang aktif. Android 14 dan yang lebih baru membatasi hal ini.

cross_platform.limit_ios_input: iOS tidak mengizinkan keyboard dan mouse jarak jauh. Hanya melihat dan chat yang berfungsi.
cross_platform.limit_ios_appstore: Aplikasi hanya tersedia melalui App Store. Versi uji dibagikan melalui TestFlight.
cross_platform.limit_web_https: Kualitas video penuh di browser memerlukan HTTPS. Melalui HTTP biasa, lebih sedikit format video yang berfungsi.
cross_platform.limit_web_codec: Format video yang berfungsi tergantung pada browser. H.264 berfungsi hampir di mana saja, VP9 dan AV1 bervariasi.
cross_platform.limit_web_performance: Browser membatasi kecepatan: browser tidak dapat menggunakan perangkat keras grafis secara langsung.
cross_platform.limit_chrome_crostini: Agen penuh hanya berjalan di lingkungan Linux ChromeOS (Crostini).
cross_platform.limit_chrome_pwa: Sebagai aplikasi web, hanya fitur browser yang tersedia, bukan fitur agen.
cross_platform.limit_chrome_input: Keyboard dan mouse jarak jauh hanya berfungsi di dalam lingkungan Linux.

sdk_studio.empty_desc: Seret node dari daftar ke kanvas, atau mulai dari templat.

sdk_studio.small_screen: Pembuat alur paling baik digunakan di layar yang lebih besar. Di layar sentuh, hubungkan node lewat Hubungkan ke di pengaturan node.
sdk_studio.add_hint: Seret node ke kanvas, atau klik untuk menambahkannya di tengah.

updates.install_recovered: Pembaruan selesai di server setelah koneksi browser terputus

server_mgmt.subtitle: Bidang kendali seperti kokpit untuk host konsol NeoDesk (BETA).

server_mgmt.host_uptime_hint: Waktu sejak mesin dinyalakan. Memulai ulang konsol tidak mengatur ulangnya.

server_attestation.title: Sertifikasi Kinerja Server
server_attestation.subtitle: Benchmark kinerja yang menentukan kapasitas koneksi jarak jauh bersamaan pada ambang CPU, RAM, dan disk 80%.
server_attestation.warning_body: Uji ini membuka hingga 500 koneksi simulasi ke server ID dan relay dan berlangsung hingga 10 menit. Uji membebani server produksi, jadi jalankan di luar jam sibuk.
server_attestation.tier_bronze_desc: 1 sampai 25 koneksi. Server virtual kecil dengan 1–2 vCPU dan 2–4 GB RAM.
server_attestation.tier_iron_desc: 26 sampai 75 koneksi. Server kelas menengah dengan 2–4 vCPU dan 4–8 GB RAM.
server_attestation.tier_platinum_desc: 76 sampai 200 koneksi. Server cepat dengan 4–8 vCPU dan 8–16 GB RAM.
server_attestation.tier_titanium_desc: 201 sampai 400 koneksi. Infrastruktur lebih besar dengan 8 vCPU atau lebih dan 16–32 GB RAM.
server_attestation.tier_obsidian_desc: 401 koneksi atau lebih. Perangkat keras khusus dengan 16 vCPU atau lebih, minimal 32 GB RAM, dan penyimpanan NVMe.
server_attestation.docker_note: Di Docker, CPU dan memori bisa berupa batas kontainer, bukan mesin.
server_attestation.badge_settings_desc: Setelah uji yang berhasil, halaman masuk menampilkan lencana kecil berisi nama konsol, tingkat, dan jumlah koneksi. Anda dapat mengubah tooltip-nya dan mengganti nama tingkat.
server_attestation.badge_title_hint: Muncul saat penunjuk diarahkan ke lencana. Biarkan kosong untuk memakai default.
server_attestation.confirm_run: Selama hingga 10 menit server menangani koneksi simulasi tambahan. Perangkat mungkin terhubung lebih lambat selama uji.
server_attestation.mode_estimated: Hasil ini perkiraan: uji tidak dapat membuka koneksi WebSocket ke server, jadi dihitung dari CPU dan memori saat diam.
server_attestation.incomplete: Uji selesai tanpa hasil. Detailnya ada di laporan.
server_attestation.page_description: Uji beban yang memperkirakan berapa koneksi jarak jauh yang dapat ditangani server sebelum CPU, memori, atau disk mencapai 80 %.
server_attestation.result_sentence: Diuji pada {date}: server menangani {count} koneksi sebelum mencapai 80 %. Tingkat: {tier}.
server_attestation.tier_names_hint: Nama tingkat. Biarkan kolom kosong untuk memakai nama di daftar atas.
server_attestation.stopped_earlier: Uji kapasitas dihentikan. Hasil yang ditampilkan berasal dari uji sebelumnya.

address.hint: Komputer menjangkau server lewat nama atau alamat IP ini. Tautan undangan dan skrip instalasi memuatnya.

https.title: Pasang HTTPS di depan konsol
https.hint: Desktop jarak jauh di browser membutuhkannya, dan tautan undangan tidak lagi memberi peringatan.

computer.title: Tambahkan komputer pertama Anda
computer.hint: Tautan undangan memasang NeoDesk di komputer itu, lalu komputer bergabung ke server ini.

session.title: Buka sesi jarak jauh
session.hint: Pilih komputer di daftar perangkat lalu sambungkan, di browser atau dengan aplikasi NeoDesk.

people.title: Tambahkan orang yang membantu
people.hint: Beri setiap orang akun sendiri dengan peran, atau aktifkan single sign-on atau LDAP.

backup.title: Buat cadangan
backup.hint: Cadangan menyimpan kunci server. Tanpa kunci itu, setiap komputer harus disiapkan ulang. Langkah ini tercentang oleh cadangan di Server, Cadangan, manual atau terjadwal; cadangan dari skrip instalasi tidak dihitung.

client_branding.subtitle: White-label for NeoDesk desktop clients and a compatible subset for RustDesk.
client_branding.hint: Klien NeoDesk dan agen dukungan memakai semua yang ada di halaman ini. Klien RustDesk biasa hanya mendapat nama perusahaan.
client_branding.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG, atau WebP, maksimal 512 KiB.
client_branding.preview_rustdesk_hint: Stock RustDesk does not call /api/branding — these options go in strategy.config_options.
client_branding.save_failed: Tidak bisa menyimpan. Perubahan Anda masih ada di sini.
client_branding.logo_invalid: Gunakan gambar PNG, JPEG, atau WebP.
client_branding.page_description: Nama, kontak, warna, dan logo yang ditampilkan klien NeoDesk dan agen dukungan kepada penggunanya.
client_branding.contact_note: Ditampilkan di klien agar pengguna tahu siapa yang membantu mereka dan cara menghubungi Anda.
client_branding.company_hint: Biarkan NeoDesk untuk memakai nama bawaan. Nama lain juga akan sampai ke klien RustDesk biasa.
client_branding.support_hint: Orang atau tim yang bisa dimintai bantuan, misalnya layanan bantuan TI.
client_branding.accent_hint: Dipakai untuk tombol dan sorotan di klien. Masukkan nilai hex seperti #4f6ef7.
client_branding.accent_invalid: Warna aksen harus berupa nilai hex seperti #4f6ef7.
client_branding.no_logo: Tidak ada logo. Klien menampilkan logo NeoDesk.
client_branding.effect: Klien menerapkan perubahan saat berikutnya menghubungi server.
client_branding.preview_note: Kira-kira seperti ini klien menampilkan nilai tersebut. Pratinjau mengikuti formulir saat Anda mengetik.
client_branding.defaults_in_use: Belum ada yang disimpan di sini: klien menampilkan nilai di bawah sampai Anda menyimpan nilai Anda sendiri.

free.title: NeoDesk gratis
free.body: Remote desktop open source — tanpa lisensi seat, tanpa lock-in. Host sendiri.

remote.title: Dukungan jarak jauh di bawah kendali Anda
remote.body: Hubungkan endpoint dari konsol Anda. Sesi tetap di infrastruktur Anda.

secure.title: Keamanan bawaan
secure.body: Autentikasi operator, kontrol sesi, dan attestation server bila diperlukan.

platforms.title: Windows, Linux, dan macOS
platforms.body: Satu konsol untuk agen di platform yang sudah didukung tim Anda.

agents.title: Agen NeoDesk
agents.subtitle: Klien Support hanya masuk dibangun di NeoDesk-Client — panel ini mengimpor dan menyajikannya.
agents.what_body: Agen Support NeoDesk adalah klien desktop hanya untuk koneksi masuk. Mereka mendaftar ke server Anda, menampilkan QR pemasangan, dan menerima dukungan jarak jauh. Mereka tidak memulai koneksi keluar ke perangkat lain.
agents.note_no_build: Konsol ini tidak membuat penginstal. Rilis bertanda tangan berasal dari proyek NeoDesk-Client.
agents.get_body: Unduh paket Support Agent bertanda tangan dari rilis NeoDesk-Client, atau bagikan portal publik server ini setelah mengimpor di bawah.
agents.sync_hint: Impor mengunduh rilis agen bertanda tangan terbaru dari GitHub dan memeriksa tanda tangannya. Setelah itu, pengguna bisa mengunduh agen dari halaman unduhan server ini.
agents.sync_empty: Belum ada. Halaman unduhan tetap kosong sampai Anda mengimpor rilis.
agents.step1: Impor rilis terbaru di halaman ini, atau unduh agen dari GitHub.
agents.step2: Instal agen di komputer orang yang dibantu dan masukkan alamat server ini.
agents.step3: Buka Pasangkan dengan kode, buat kode sekali pakai, lalu masukkan di agen bersama alamat server.
agents.step4: Jika mode pendaftaran Anda meminta persetujuan, setujui perangkat di {page}. Lalu hubungkan ke perangkat itu dari daftar perangkat.
agents.pair_body: Pemasangan memakai kode sekali pakai yang singkat (berlaku 10 menit). QR agen masih dapat dipindai dari Pasangkan dengan kode → Pindai QR agen.
agents.branding_body: Agen memuatnya dari branding aplikasi klien saat dimulai, jadi perubahan tidak memerlukan penginstal baru.
agents.page_description: Aplikasi NeoDesk kecil untuk orang yang Anda bantu. Aplikasi ini menerima bantuan jarak jauh dan tidak bisa terhubung ke perangkat lain.
agents.sync_no_permission: Untuk mengimpor, Anda perlu izin mengelola pendaftaran. Minta kepada administrator.
agents.portal_hint: Halaman publik tempat pengguna Anda mengunduh agen. Bagikan alamatnya kepada mereka.
agents.portal_open_hint: Menampilkan halaman seperti yang dilihat pengguna Anda.

pairing.title: Kode pemasangan
pairing.subtitle: Siapkan klien NeoDesk dengan alamat server dan kode sekali pakai yang singkat, bukan string konfigurasi yang panjang.
pairing.generate_hint: Bagikan kode ini dan alamat server. Berlaku 10 menit, sekali pakai.
pairing.host_hint: Alamat yang diketik klien: nama domain atau IP, tanpa port.
pairing.code_hint: Ketik kode ini di perangkat. Kode hanya ditampilkan sekali.
pairing.copy_failed: Pilih kode dan salin secara manual
pairing.active_hint: Server hanya menyimpan sidik jari setiap kode, jadi kode tidak bisa ditampilkan lagi. Cabut kode agar langsung tidak berfungsi.
pairing.empty: Tidak ada kode aktif. Kode hilang dari daftar ini setelah dipakai atau kedaluwarsa.
pairing.label_hint: Hanya ditampilkan di daftar kode aktif, agar Anda bisa membedakannya.
pairing.valid_under_minute: kurang dari satu menit, hanya sekali pakai
pairing.code_empty: Buat kode dan kode itu muncul di sini, cukup besar untuk dibacakan.

mail.invite_heading: Set up remote support on your computer
mail.invite_intro: {sender} from {server} invites you to set up NeoDesk on your computer. {server} can then help you on it.
mail.invite_steps: Open this link on the computer you want to set up:
mail.invite_code: Sudah punya NeoDesk? Buka Pengaturan, Server, Gabung ke server, lalu masukkan kode ini:
mail.support_steps: Buka tautan ini di komputer yang perlu dibantu. Unduh aplikasi kecilnya, buka, lalu klik Izinkan. Tidak ada yang dipasang.
mail.footer: Dikirim oleh {host} untuk {server}. Jika Anda tidak menunggu email ini, abaikan saja.
mail.welcome_lead: Siapkan NeoDesk di komputer Anda. Hanya butuh beberapa menit.
mail.welcome_step_3: Selesai: mulai sekarang dukungan {company} dapat membantu Anda, dan Anda melihat saat seseorang terhubung.
mail.welcome_link: Jika tombol tidak berfungsi, buka tautan ini di komputer:

invite.title: Add a computer
invite.subtitle: Make an invite link. The person opens it on their computer, and it joins this server. Every field is optional.
invite.name: Name
invite.name_hint: Shown in Devices. Leave it empty to use the computer's own name.
invite.email_hint: NeoDesk emails the link to this address. Leave it empty to copy the link yourself.
invite.note: The computer joins approved, named and in its folder. Nobody types a server address or key.
invite.create_failed: Couldn't create the invite. Try again.
invite.result_once: Send this link to the person at the computer. It works once, until {date}.
invite.result_many: Send this link to the people at the computers. It works {count} times, until {date}.
invite.result_unlimited: Send this link to the people at the computers. It works until {date}.
invite.result_note_named: {name} shows up in Devices as soon as it joins.
invite.result_note_folder: {name} shows up in Devices, in {folder}, as soon as it joins.
invite.result_note: The computer shows up in Devices as soon as it joins.

support.title: Quick support
support.text: Send this link to the person who needs help. They download a small app and click Allow, then you can connect. The link works once, for one hour.
support.create_failed: Couldn't make the link. Try again.
support.state_waiting: Waiting for the person to open the link. The link expires at {time}.
support.state_asking: The app is open on their computer. Waiting for them to click Allow.
support.state_allowed_hint: You don't need a password. The session ends when they click Stop or close the app.
support.state_allowed_wait: {computer} allowed access. The app has not handed over its password yet; you may be asked for it.
support.state_declined: They declined. Make a new link if they still need help.
support.state_ended_customer: The session has ended: they closed the app.
support.state_timeout: The session has ended: the app stopped answering.
support.state_expired: The link expired before anyone used it. Make a new link if the person still needs help.
support.close_hint: You can close this. The session stays open; find it under Help requests.
support.unblocked: {name} is unblocked. Make a new link and send it again.

result.code_hint: For NeoDesk that is already installed: Settings, Server, Join a server.
result.qr_caption: The QR code opens the link on a phone or tablet, for example to send it on from there.
result.insecure: This console is not on HTTPS. The person's computer cannot check that it talks to this server; only use the link on a network you trust.
result.mail_failed: Couldn't send the email. The link still works.

public.join_title: Set up remote support on this computer
public.join_lead: {server} invited you to add this computer. After setup, {server} can help you on it.
public.support_lead: Download the small support app and open it. You will be asked to allow access. Nothing gets installed.
public.insecure: This page does not use a secure connection. Someone on your network could change the download. Only go on if {server} told you to.
public.no_release: There is no download right now. Try again later, or ask the person who sent you this link.
public.command_hint_join: Open a terminal, paste this command and press Enter. It asks for your password, installs NeoDesk and adds this computer to {server}.
public.command_hint_support: Open a terminal, paste this command and press Enter. It starts the support app without installing it.
public.code_hint_join: Sudah punya NeoDesk? Buka Pengaturan, Server, Gabung ke server, lalu masukkan kode ini dan alamat server di bawah:
public.code_hint_support: If the app asks for a code, enter:
public.footer_join_sender: This invite works until {date}. Sent by {sender}, {server}.
public.phone_title_join: Open this link on the computer you want to set up
public.phone_lead_join: {server} invited you to add a computer. NeoDesk runs on Windows, Mac and Linux, not on phones.
public.phone_title_support: Open this link on the computer you need help with
public.phone_lead_support: The support app runs on Windows, Mac and Linux, not on phones.
public.gone_join: This invite has expired or was already used. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
public.gone_support: This support link has expired or was already used. Support links work once and for one hour. Ask the person who helps you for a new one.
public.load_failed: The page could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
public.join_steps_windows_3: Windows bertanya apakah Windows Command Processor dari Microsoft Windows boleh membuat perubahan. Itu penyiapan NeoDesk yang sedang memasang dirinya: klik Ya. Komputer lalu bergabung ke {server} dengan sendirinya.
public.join_steps_windows_msi_3: Windows bertanya apakah NeoDesk boleh membuat perubahan. Periksa bahwa namanya {publisher}, lalu klik Ya. Setelah itu komputer bergabung ke {server} dengan sendirinya.
public.join_steps_macos_1: Open the downloaded file and drag NeoDesk into Applications.
public.join_steps_macos_2: Open NeoDesk from Applications. If your Mac says it can't check the app: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway.
public.join_steps_macos_3: Come back to this page and click Open NeoDesk.
public.join_steps_macos_4: When NeoDesk asks, allow Screen Recording and Accessibility in System Settings. Without them {server} can't see or use the screen.
public.support_steps_windows_2: Check that it shows {supporter}, then click Allow.
public.support_steps_windows_3: When you are done, click Stop at the top of your screen.
public.support_steps_macos_1: Open the downloaded file. It runs from your Downloads folder. If your Mac says it can't check the app: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway.
public.support_steps_macos_2: Allow Screen Recording and Accessibility when your Mac asks.
public.support_steps_macos_3: Check that it shows {supporter}, then click Allow.
public.support_steps_macos_4: When you are done, click Stop at the top of your screen.
public.welcome_step_3: Selesai: mulai sekarang dukungan {company} dapat membantu Anda, dan Anda melihat saat seseorang terhubung.

errors.invalid_body: The request could not be read.
errors.invalid_name: The name may have at most 64 characters and no < or >.
errors.invalid_lifetime: Pick how long the link works: 1 hour to 30 days.
errors.invalid_uses: Pick how often the link can be used: 1 to 1000 times.
errors.folder_forbidden: You may not add computers to that folder.
errors.too_many_codes: There are 500 open links. Revoke some before you make more.
errors.smtp_not_configured: Email is not set up on this server (Settings, Email).
errors.mail_failed: Couldn't send the email. The link still works.
errors.not_found: That link or session does not exist any more.
errors.no_password: The app has not handed over its password yet.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid_or_expired: This link has expired or was already used.

guide.waiting: Masih menunggu komputer. Tautan berlaku sampai {date}.
guide.joined_lead: Empat langkah singkat. Lewati membiarkan semuanya seperti sekarang.
guide.name_hint: Ditampilkan di Perangkat dan di penampil.
guide.folder_hint: Siapa yang dapat melihat dan menjangkau komputer ini ditentukan oleh foldernya.
guide.no_permission: Peran Anda tidak dapat mengubah ini. Semuanya tetap seperti sekarang.
guide.reach_password: Dengan kata sandinya: seseorang di komputer menetapkan kata sandi permanen di NeoDesk, di Pengaturan, Keamanan. Anda mengetiknya saat terhubung.
guide.reach_accept: Tanpa kata sandi: orang di komputer melihat siapa yang ingin terhubung lalu mengklik Terima.
guide.test_lead: Buka sesi untuk memeriksa bahwa semuanya berfungsi. NeoDesk di komputer meminta orang di sana untuk menerima.
guide.test_offline: {name} sedang offline. Nyalakan dan tunggu sampai tampil online di sini.
guide.key_changed: Komputer ini pernah ada di sini dengan kunci lain.
guide.key_changed_hint: Jika komputer ini diinstal ulang atau direset, setujui kunci baru. Lalu buka undangan di komputer lagi.
guide.key_approved: Kunci baru disetujui. Buka undangan di komputer lagi.
guide.refused: Komputer dengan ID {id} mencoba undangan ini dan ditolak. Periksa Perangkat: mungkin diblokir atau dihapus.
guide.reach_policy: Tanpa bertanya: akses tanpa pengawasan mengikuti kebijakan. Staf yang masuk ke NeoDesk dan boleh terhubung masuk tanpa klik jika kebijakan organisasi atau kebijakan akses komputer mengizinkannya.

ui_form.save_failed: Gagal menyimpan. Perubahan Anda masih ada.

portal.title: Unduh agen dukungan
portal.description: Instal aplikasi kecil ini di komputer Anda agar tim dukungan Anda bisa membantu dari jarak jauh.
portal.no_release: Administrator Anda belum menyediakan agen. Minta mereka mengimpor versi terbaru agen dukungan di konsol, lalu muat ulang halaman ini.
portal.incomplete: Agen sudah diimpor, tetapi beberapa filenya hilang. Minta administrator Anda mengimpor versi terbaru sekali lagi.
portal.footer: Setelah instalasi, administrator Anda akan menjelaskan cara menghubungkan agen ke server ini.

remote_viewer.phone_title: Penampil web memerlukan layar yang lebih besar
remote_viewer.phone_body: Di ponsel, buka perangkat ini di aplikasi RustDesk. Aplikasi harus terpasang di ponsel.
remote_viewer.password_intro: {name} meminta kata sandi. Gunakan kata sandi yang diatur di perangkat itu dalam NeoDesk atau RustDesk.
remote_viewer.tfa_intro: {name} meminta kode dari aplikasi autentikator yang ditautkan ke perangkat tersebut.
remote_viewer.password_wrong: Kata sandi tidak diterima. Periksa lalu coba lagi.
remote_viewer.try_ended: Hubungkan ulang untuk melanjutkan, atau tutup tab.
remote_viewer.new_connection_hint: Hubungkan ke perangkat lain di tab baru
remote_viewer.keep_open_hint: Biarkan kontrol tetap terbuka saat Anda bekerja
remote_viewer.remember_password: Ingat kata sandi di browser ini
remote_viewer.chat_empty: Pesan Anda muncul di layar perangkat. Balasan ditampilkan di sini.
remote_viewer.slow_find: Ini memakan waktu lama saat server sibuk atau browser ini tidak dapat menjangkaunya. Periksa alamat server dan jaringan Anda.
remote_viewer.slow_route: Ini memakan waktu lama saat server relay lambat atau diblokir firewall.
remote_viewer.slow_accept: {name} mungkin sedang dalam mode tidur, atau seseorang harus menerima koneksi di perangkat. Minta mereka mengklik Terima.
remote_viewer.step_signin: Masuk, jika perangkat meminta kata sandi
remote_viewer.slow_signin: Proses masuk memakan waktu lama saat perangkat sibuk.
remote_viewer.slow_screen: Perangkat sedang memulai penangkapan layar. Pada jaringan yang lambat, ini butuh sedikit waktu.
remote_viewer.fail_permission: Anda tidak memiliki izin untuk terhubung ke {name}.
remote_viewer.try_permission: Minta administrator memberi Anda akses ke perangkat ini.
remote_viewer.fail_feature_off: This kind of session is turned off for your account on this server.
remote_viewer.try_feature_off: An administrator can turn it on in your account's client features.
remote_viewer.try_password: Hubungkan ulang dan masukkan kata sandi yang diatur di perangkat dalam NeoDesk atau RustDesk.
remote_viewer.try_refused: Seseorang di perangkat menolaknya, atau perangkat hanya menerima koneksi yang disetujui di sana. Minta mereka menerima, lalu hubungkan ulang.
remote_viewer.try_timeout: Perangkat mungkin sedang dalam mode tidur, sibuk, atau offline. Bangunkan atau tunggu sebentar, lalu hubungkan ulang.
remote_viewer.fail_notfound: ID ini tidak terdaftar di server.
remote_viewer.try_notfound: Periksa ID. Perangkat mungkin telah dihapus atau didaftarkan ulang dengan ID baru.
remote_viewer.try_offline: Perangkat ini belum menghubungi server akhir-akhir ini. Nyalakan atau bangunkan, lalu hubungkan ulang.
remote_viewer.fail_https: {name} tidak dapat ditampilkan melalui HTTP biasa.
remote_viewer.try_https: Perangkat ini tidak memiliki encoder H.264, dan melalui HTTP browser hanya memutar H.264. Buka konsol melalui HTTPS untuk melihat layarnya.
remote_viewer.fail_limit: Server tidak mengizinkan koneksi ini saat ini.
remote_viewer.try_limit: Lisensi atau jumlah koneksi sudah mencapai batas. Hubungi administrator.
remote_viewer.try_relay: Pastikan server relay berjalan dan browser ini dapat menjangkaunya, lalu hubungkan ulang.
remote_viewer.try_dropped_early: Perangkat mungkin sedang dalam mode tidur atau offline, atau tidak dapat menjangkau server relay. Bangunkan, lalu hubungkan ulang.
remote_viewer.try_dropped: Jaringan antara browser ini, server, dan perangkat terganggu. Hubungkan ulang. Jika terus terjadi, periksa jaringan perangkat.
remote_viewer.try_generic: Hubungkan ulang. Jika terus gagal, salin detail di bawah dan kirimkan ke administrator Anda.
remote_viewer.fail_insecure: Koneksi ke {name} dihentikan karena tidak dapat diamankan.
remote_viewer.try_insecure: Tidak ada kata sandi yang dikirim. Seseorang di antara browser ini dan perangkat mungkin menyadap, atau kunci server belum disiapkan. Minta administrator memeriksa server.
remote_viewer.screen_keys: Tombol dikirim ke perangkat, termasuk Tab. Tekan F8 atau Ctrl+Alt+Shift+G untuk keluar dari layar.
remote_viewer.layout_needs_width: Sesuai susunan dan Kisi memerlukan jendela selebar minimal 900 piksel dan mouse.
remote_viewer.spread_screens: Satu layar di setiap monitor saya
remote_viewer.all_in_windows: Setiap layar terbuka di jendelanya sendiri.
remote_viewer.background_displays: Layar yang tidak sedang Anda kerjakan
remote_viewer.display_shortcuts: Di layar, Ctrl+Alt+Shift dengan angka 1 sampai 9 memilih layar, L mengganti tata letak, Z ukuran, dan P membuka layar di jendela tersendiri.
remote_viewer.window_blocked: Browser memblokir jendela baru. Izinkan pop-up untuk situs ini, lalu coba lagi.
remote_viewer.window_without_viewer: Jendela ini menampilkan layar dari sesi jarak jauh. Buka dari penampil dengan Buka di jendela tersendiri.
remote_viewer.open_in_new_tab_hint: Pindahkan sesi ini ke tab tersendiri: sesi tersambung lagi di sana dan berakhir di sini
remote_viewer.no_keyboard_lock: Browser ini menyimpan beberapa pintasan untuk dirinya, juga di layar penuh: Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T, Ctrl+N, tombol Windows, dan Esc keluar dari layar penuh. Tindakan mengirim tombol Windows, Alt+Tab, dan Ctrl+Alt+Del ke komputer jarak jauh.
remote_viewer.no_screen_placement: Browser ini tidak bisa menaruh jendela di layar Anda yang lain. Seret jendela setiap tampilan ke layar yang Anda inginkan.
remote_viewer.phone_turn: Atau putar ponsel ke samping: dalam mode lanskap sesi terbuka di sini di browser.
remote_viewer.no_open_sessions: Tidak ada sesi yang terbuka. Sambungkan dengan ID, atau pilih perangkat di bawah.
remote_viewer.fail_signin_closed: {name} menutup koneksi saat browser ini masuk.
remote_viewer.try_signin_closed: Perangkat menolak proses masuk. Hubungkan lagi dan masuk kembali. Jika terus terjadi, minta administrator memeriksa log NeoDesk di perangkat.
remote_viewer.tab_close_hint: Tekan Delete untuk menutup sesi ini.
remote_viewer.wait_person: Waiting for {person} to accept on their screen.
remote_viewer.wait_someone: Waiting for someone at {name} to accept on their screen.
remote_viewer.wait_person_hint: {person} sees a window that asks to let you connect, with Allow and Decline.
remote_viewer.wait_someone_hint: The person there sees a window that asks to let you connect, with Allow and Decline.
remote_viewer.unblocked_try: {name} is unblocked. It checks in with the server within a minute; then reconnect.
remote_viewer.keyboard_hint: Ctrl+Alt+Del, tombol Windows, dan mengetik teks
remote_viewer.cad_hint: Membuka layar masuk atau layar keamanan
remote_viewer.settings_hint: Kualitas gambar, lihat saja, mode privasi, perekaman, dan lainnya
remote_viewer.block_input_hint: Orang di perangkat tidak dapat memakai mouse atau keyboard mereka
remote_viewer.privacy_hint: Layar di perangkat menjadi gelap selama Anda bekerja
remote_viewer.clipboard_off_hint: Salin dan tempel antara kedua komputer berhenti
remote_viewer.lock_after_hint: Perangkat terkunci saat Anda memutuskan sambungan
remote_viewer.advanced_hint: Laju bingkai, mode keyboard, dan kodek video
remote_viewer.files_hint: Menyalin berkas ke dan dari perangkat
remote_viewer.more_hint: Info sesi, segarkan layar, mulai ulang perangkat

device_offline.why: It has not checked in with the server for a while.
device_offline.todo: Turn it on or wake it up, and check that NeoDesk runs on it. Then reconnect.

device_unknown.why: No computer with this ID is registered on this server.
device_unknown.todo: Check the ID. If the computer was removed, add it again under Add computers.

device_revoked.why: Someone revoked this computer in the console, so the server refuses it, even when it is on.
device_revoked.todo: If it should connect again, unblock it here. Then reconnect.
device_revoked.todo_ask: Ask an administrator to unblock this computer, then reconnect.

device_blocked.why: Its ID is on the server's blocklist, so the server refuses it, even when it is on.
device_blocked.todo: If it should connect again, unblock it here. Then reconnect.
device_blocked.todo_ask: Ask an administrator to unblock this computer, then reconnect.

device_banned.why: An administrator banned this computer, so the server refuses it.
device_banned.todo: If it should connect again, unban it in the device panel.

device_removed.why: The computer is with the deleted devices.
device_removed.todo: Restore it in the device panel, or add it again under Add computers.

device_rejected.why: An administrator rejected this computer when it asked to join.
device_rejected.todo: Ask an administrator to allow it under Add computers, then try again.

other_machine.what: Another computer already uses the ID of {name}.
other_machine.why: The server knows this ID from a different machine.
other_machine.todo: Ask an administrator to delete the old device in the console, then try again.

key_changed.what: {name} came back with a new key.
key_changed.why: The server refuses a computer whose key changed until an administrator approves it. This keeps others from taking over its ID.
key_changed.todo: If you expected the change, approve the new key in the device panel. Then reconnect.

join_proof.what: {name} could not prove that it is the computer the server knows.
join_proof.why: The ID is enrolled already, and this computer did not sign the join with the key the server has for it.
join_proof.todo: Update NeoDesk on this computer and open the link again, or ask an administrator to delete the old device in the console.

server_unreachable.what: This browser can't reach the NeoDesk server.
server_unreachable.why: The server did not answer when the connection started.
server_unreachable.todo: Check your network, then reconnect. If it keeps failing, ask an administrator to check the server.

relay_unreachable.what: The connection to {name} could not be set up.
relay_unreachable.why: This browser could not reach the part of the server that carries the session.
relay_unreachable.todo: Reconnect. If it keeps failing, ask an administrator to check that the server's ports are open.

relay_refused.what: The server stopped the connection to {name}.
relay_refused.why: The server did not let this session through.
relay_refused.todo: Reconnect. If it keeps happening, copy the details and send them to an administrator.

no_answer.why: The server asked {name} to connect, and no answer came in time. It may be asleep or busy, or its network may block NeoDesk.
no_answer.todo: Wake it up or wait a moment, then reconnect.

not_authorized.why: The server does not let your account start sessions to this computer.
not_authorized.todo: Ask an administrator to give you access to this computer.

feature_off.what: This kind of session is turned off for your account.
feature_off.why: An administrator turned it off in your account's client features.
feature_off.todo: Ask an administrator to turn it on.

consent_scope.why: In this quick support session, {person} allowed only some things.
consent_scope.todo: Ask {person} to allow it in the quick support window.

license_blocked.what: The server's license does not allow this connection.
license_blocked.why: The license key does not match this server.
license_blocked.todo: Ask an administrator to check the license.

session_limit.what: The server takes no more sessions right now.
session_limit.why: The number of sessions is at the limit of its license.
session_limit.todo: Wait until another session ends, or ask an administrator.

billing_blocked.what: The server does not allow sessions to {name} right now.
billing_blocked.why: The contract of this computer does not allow sessions.
billing_blocked.todo: Ask an administrator to check the computer's contract.

client_too_old.what: NeoDesk on {name} is too old for this.
client_too_old.why: The version on the computer does not support this connection.

consent_declined.why: The person at {name} clicked Decline or closed the window that asked.
consent_declined.todo: Ask them to try again, then reconnect.

consent_timeout.why: Nobody accepted the connection on {name} within 3 minutes.
consent_timeout.todo: Ask them to watch for the window that asks, then reconnect.

consent_not_allowed.what: {person} has not allowed quick support yet.
consent_not_allowed.why: {name} offers to let you in by click only after the person clicked Allow in the quick support window.
consent_not_allowed.todo: Ask them to click Allow in the quick support window, then connect again.

consent_needs_https.what: {name} can't let you in by click.
consent_needs_https.why: This console is not on HTTPS, so quick support takes only the one-time password.
consent_needs_https.todo: Send a new quick support link: its one-time password comes to you and connects you. To accept by click, the console needs HTTPS.

consent_needs_update.what: {name} can't let you in by click.
consent_needs_update.why: NeoDesk on {name} is too old to accept by click.
consent_needs_update.todo: Send a new quick support link: its one-time password comes to you and connects you. Or ask {person} to update NeoDesk.

password_wrong.todo: Enter the password set on {name}. NeoDesk shows it on that computer under Settings, Security.

tfa_wrong.todo: Enter the current code from the authenticator app linked to {name}.

rate_limited.why: {name} blocks sign-ins for a while after several wrong ones.

device_not_allowed.why: NeoDesk on {name} only lets people in with a password, and no password is set there, or its settings turn connections off.
device_not_allowed.todo: Ask someone at {name} to set a password or allow connections under Settings, Security.

device_blocks_you.why: NeoDesk on {name} has your ID or address on its own blocklist.
device_blocks_you.todo: Ask someone at {name} to remove the block in its settings.

device_feature_off.why: NeoDesk on {name} does not allow this kind of session.
device_feature_off.todo: Ask someone at {name} to allow it under Settings, Security.

device_not_installed.what: {name} can't do this without an installed NeoDesk.
device_not_installed.why: NeoDesk runs there without being installed, and this needs the installed version.
device_not_installed.todo: Ask someone at {name} to install NeoDesk, then reconnect.

login_screen.what: {name} shows a sign-in screen NeoDesk can't share.
login_screen.why: The sign-in screen of {name} runs on Wayland, which NeoDesk can't capture.
login_screen.todo: Sign in on {name} first, or switch its sign-in screen to X11. Then reconnect.

privacy_mode.what: Someone turned on privacy mode on {name}.
privacy_mode.why: Another session holds {name} in privacy mode, which lets no second viewer in.
privacy_mode.todo: Wait until that session ends, then reconnect.

device_not_ready.what: {name} is not ready for this connection.
device_not_ready.why: NeoDesk on {name} said it can't take the session now.
device_not_ready.todo: Ask someone at {name} to open NeoDesk, then reconnect.

insecure.what: The connection to {name} was stopped because it could not be secured.
insecure.why: {name} did not prove its identity or did not encrypt the connection. Someone between this browser and the computer may be listening in, or the server key is not set up.
insecure.todo: No password was sent. Ask an administrator to check the server.

https_required.what: {name} can't be shown over plain HTTP.
https_required.why: This computer sends a video format the browser plays only over HTTPS.
https_required.todo: Open the console over HTTPS to see its screen.

signin_closed.what: {name} closed the connection when this browser signed in.
signin_closed.todo: Reconnect and sign in again. If it keeps happening, ask an administrator to look at the log of NeoDesk on the computer.

dropped_early.why: The network between this browser, the server and {name} was interrupted while the session started.
dropped_early.todo: Reconnect. If it keeps happening, check the network of the computer.

dropped.why: The network between this browser, the server and {name} was interrupted.
dropped.todo: Reconnect. If it keeps happening, check the network of the computer.

unknown.why: The cause is not known. The details below show what this browser saw.
unknown.todo: Reconnect. If it keeps failing, copy the details and send them to an administrator.

email_change.confirm_subject: Confirm your new email address for {server}
email_change.confirm_lead: {sender} changed the email address of your account {username} on {server} to this address. Confirm it to finish the change.
email_change.confirm_lead_self: You asked to use this address for your account {username} on {server}. Confirm it to finish the change.
email_change.confirm_ignore: If you didn't expect this, ignore this email. The address stays as it was.

email_change.notice_heading: Your email address is being changed
email_change.notice_lead: The email address of your account {username} on {server} is being changed to {email}. It changes once the new address is confirmed.

email_change.notice_removed_lead: The email address was removed from your account {username} on {server}.
email_change.notice_not_you: If this wasn't you, sign in and change your password, or tell your administrator.

email_change.done_text: {email} is now the email address of {username}. The account's other sessions were signed out.
email_change.no_link: Open the link from your email to confirm the address.

account_mail.expiry_why: You get this because you can change this account.
account_mail.inactive_heading: Sign in to keep your account
account_mail.inactive_lead: Your account {username} on {server} hasn't been used for a while. It is disabled on {date} unless you sign in before then.
account_mail.inactive_why: The console disables accounts that haven't signed in for {days} days.

security_notice.new_signin_subject: New sign-in to your account on {server}
security_notice.new_signin_lead: Someone signed in to your account {username} on {server} from a browser it hasn't used before.
security_notice.not_you_signin: If this was you, you don't need to do anything. If it wasn't, change your password, end the sessions you don't know under Signed-in devices on Your account, and tell your administrator.
security_notice.password_lead_self: The password of your account {username} on {server} was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
security_notice.password_lead_link: The password of your account {username} on {server} was set with a reset link. Your other sessions were signed out.
security_notice.password_lead_admin: An administrator set a new password for your account {username} on {server}. Your sessions were signed out.
security_notice.password_lead_temporary: An administrator gave your account {username} on {server} a temporary password. You choose a new password at your next sign-in. Your sessions were signed out.
security_notice.not_you_password: If you didn't expect this, tell your administrator right away. If you can still sign in, check Signed-in devices on Your account.
security_notice.two_factor_subject: Two-factor sign-in of your account on {server} changed
security_notice.two_factor_lead_on: Two-factor sign-in is now on for your account {username} on {server}.
security_notice.two_factor_lead_off: Two-factor sign-in was turned off for your account {username} on {server}. You sign in with your password alone.
security_notice.two_factor_lead_off_admin: An administrator turned off two-factor sign-in for your account {username} on {server}. You sign in with your password alone until you turn it on again on Your account.
security_notice.two_factor_lead_reset: An administrator reset two-factor sign-in for your account {username} on {server}. Your old authenticator codes and recovery codes no longer work. You set it up again at your next sign-in.
security_notice.two_factor_lead_codes_used_up: You used the last recovery code of your account {username} on {server}. Make new ones on Your account, so you can still sign in when you lose your authenticator.
security_notice.two_factor_lead_codes_renewed: New recovery codes were made for your account {username} on {server}. The old ones no longer work.
security_notice.two_factor_lead_codes_invalidated: An administrator made the recovery codes of your account {username} on {server} stop working. Make new ones on Your account with your authenticator app.
security_notice.not_you_two_factor: If you didn't expect this, change your password and tell your administrator right away.
security_notice.email_subject: The email address of your account on {server} was changed
security_notice.email_lead: Mail for your account {username} on {server} now goes to another address. This is the last mail to this address about it.
security_notice.not_you_email: If you didn't expect this, tell your administrator right away.

impersonation.refused_no_console: {username} can't sign in to the console, so there is nothing to view.

impersonation.not_active: You are not viewing NeoDesk as another account.

impersonation.read_only_hint: You are viewing NeoDesk as {username}. Nothing can be changed here.

quick_support_feedback.default_text: Anything else you want to tell us?
quick_support_feedback.title: Feedback after quick support
quick_support_feedback.description: When a session the person allowed has ended, the quick support app asks them these questions. Answering is up to them.
quick_support_feedback.effect: Applies to the next quick support session that ends. Answers already given stay as they were asked.

quick_support_feedback.questions_help: In this order. At most {max}; the person may leave out the optional ones.

errors.too_many_questions: The form holds at most 10 questions.
errors.unknown_kind: This kind of question does not exist.

quick_support_feedback.page_description: What people answered after quick support, newest first.

receiver_app.page_description: Install the NeoDesk app on computers without anyone clicking through it. The computers join this server with a token.
receiver_app.token_note: For many computers, use a rollout token: computers join with it until it expires or reaches its limit. A token from Device tokens for one computer adds just that computer. The token decides the folder and the policies.
receiver_app.token_hint: It is shown once, when the token is created.
receiver_app.token_invalid: This is not a token. A token has 16 to 128 letters and digits.
receiver_app.token_filled: The new token is filled in.
receiver_app.folder_hint: Used when the token has no folder of its own.
receiver_app.no_release: No Support Agent release is imported yet, so there is no installer to download. Import one under
receiver_app.install_note: The download holds {msi} and install.cmd. Run install.cmd as administrator, or run the command below next to {msi}, for example from your software deployment.
receiver_app.command_needs_token: Enter a token to see the command.
receiver_app.properties_note: The values the installer needs for this server. TOKEN is needed when new computers need a token or approval.

errors.invalid_body: The request could not be read.
errors.token_unknown: This token does not exist, was revoked or has expired.
errors.token_used: A computer has already joined with this token. Create a new one, or a rollout token for many computers.
errors.no_release: There is no installer for this processor. Import the Support Agent release under Support agents.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
errors.token_full: All the computers this rollout token allows have joined. Raise its limit under Device tokens or create a new one.

quick_support_receiver.title: Keep NeoDesk on the computer
quick_support_receiver.description: After the session the quick support app can ask the person whether to keep NeoDesk on the computer. If they agree, it installs the NeoDesk app and the computer joins this server, also when new computers need a token or approval.
quick_support_receiver.effect: Applies to quick support sessions that start from now on.
quick_support_receiver.offer: Offer to install after quick support
quick_support_receiver.offer_help: The person is asked after the feedback. Installing needs administrator rights on the computer.
